summary: This is a Docker Compose configuration that defines a service called 'joomla'. It builds a Docker image from the current directory (the context) and passes in a PHP version argument during the build process, with a sensible default of PHP 8.3 with Apache if no version is specified. The project name itself also defaults to 'your-project-name' if not provided.

explanations.1: The ${PROJECT_NAME:-your-project-name} syntax means 'use the PROJECT_NAME environment variable, but if it's not set, use the default value your-project-name instead'.
explanations.8: The context: . tells Docker to build the image using files from the current directory (the dot means current directory).
explanations.10: The args section defines build-time variables that get passed to the Dockerfile during the image build process.
explanations.12: This passes the PHP_VERSION variable to the Dockerfile, defaulting to version 8.3 with Apache if the PHP_VERSION environment variable isn't already set.
